title: Zesty Salty Croatian Shrimp Skewers
description: A salty and snappy Croatian dish featuring shrimp, sherry, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for kids and adults alike. This recipe is a twist on traditional Croatian cuisine with a deep-fry agemono style.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sherry, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few skewers to the skillet and deep-fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked skewers to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the Zesty Salty Croatian Shrimp Skewers hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
